title: Lynkist
shortDescription: WhatsApp Marketing Platform with AI Agents
context: A WhatsApp marketing and automation SaaS platform.
problem: Building scalable message routing, catalog/template management, and AI agent automation.
contribution: Technical ownership across backend development, integrations, feature implementation, testing, product requirements, and coordination with the team. Handled backend/API development, Meta/WhatsApp integrations, webhook handling, templates, catalog, flows, campaigns, contacts, QR/link functionality, AI agents and automation, Redis/Celery background processing. Also managed UAT, Playwright automation testing, production debugging, feature planning, product requirement handling, task assignment, team coordination, customer/product discussions, onboarding/product support, and customer acquisition planning.
architecture: Python/FastAPI backend with background processing queues in Celery and Redis.
keyChallenges: Ensuring reliable message delivery and robust handling of high-volume webhooks.
testingReliability: Playwright automation testing, UAT, and production debugging.

title: Real-Time Trading Data POC
shortDescription: Complete flow for real-time trading data handling and UI updates.
context: A technical project developed as a complete flow for real-time trading data handling and UI updates, addressing broker-side WebSocket connection limitations.
problem: Existing broker-side WebSocket limitations allowed only a limited number of simultaneous connections, causing delays in market data reaching user dashboards.
contribution: Handled the flow from real-time broker data through the backend and WebSocket communication to the JavaScript UI. Handled real-time market data updates, data fetching, WebSocket communication to the UI, UI updates based on incoming data, order updates, and complete data flow between backend and frontend.
architecture: Broker WebSocket / Real-Time Data → Go Service → goroutines / connection handling → Redis → Django / PostgreSQL → WebSocket → JavaScript UI → Real-Time UI / Order Updates
keyChallenges: Handling high-concurrency WebSocket connections efficiently and syncing across the entire stack.

title: AI Job Application Platform

architecture: Django backend with Celery/Redis for background processing, communicating with external APIs (Adzuna, Gemini) and serving a React frontend.
keyChallenges: Ensuring accurate data extraction from unstructured resumes.
